name: Keyword Prioritization Scorer
formula: score = 100 * (wR*R + wV*V + wD*(10-D) + wC*C) / (10 * (wR + wV + wD + wC))
assumptions: All ratings are user-entered judgments on a 0-10 scale — tool has no live keyword data.
Difficulty is inverted: lower difficulty scores higher.
Weights are editorial defaults; user can adjust.
source: MA2-defined transparent heuristic rubric (deterministic given inputs; not a measurement of real competition)

name: Content Scannability Checker
formula: score = 100 - (P_heading + P_paragraph + P_sentence + P_media + P_lists), clamped to [0,100]; P_heading = 20 if zero H2/H3 else 0; P_paragraph = 15 if avgWordsPerParagraph > 80 else 7.5 if > 50 else 0; P_sentence = 15 if avgWordsPerSentence > 25 else 7.5 if > 20 else 0; P_media = 10 if imagesPer1000Words < 1 and words > 500 else 0; P_lists = 10 if no list items and words > 800 else 0; grade: A>=85, B>=70, C>=55, D>=40, F<40
assumptions: Thresholds are editorial readability conventions (short paragraphs/sentences aid scanning); not a published Google metric.
Markdown headings (#, ##) and HTML headings both recognized.
Image count is user-declared or counted from /markdown images in pasted content.

name: Anchor Text Diversity Analyzer
formula: exactMatchRatio = exactMatchCount / totalAnchors; H = -SUM over anchor-text groups of (p_i * log2(p_i)), where p_i = groupCount_i / totalAnchors (groups = lowercased, trimmed, punctuation-stripped anchor text); flags: exactMatchRatio > 0.30 -> 'over-optimized' warning; H < 1.0 with totalAnchors >= 10 -> 'low diversity' warning
assumptions: Grouping normalizes case/whitespace/punctuation only — no stemming, no semantic grouping.
The 0.30 exact-match flag and 1.0 entropy flag are editorial heuristics, not Google-published thresholds.
source: Standard information-theory entropy; thresholds are MA2-defined editorial heuristics

name: Sentence Length Analyzer
formula: Flesch Reading Ease = 206.835 - 1.015*(words/sentences) - 84.6*(syllables/words); Flesch-Kincaid Grade = 0.39*(words/sentences) + 11.8*(syllables/words) - 15.59; Gunning Fog = 0.4*((words/sentences) + 100*(complexWords/words)); ARI = 4.71*(characters/words) + 0.5*(words/sentences) - 21.43

variables.meaning: words with >= 3 syllables, excluding proper nouns/common suffixes

units: FRE 0-100 (higher=easier); grade levels in US school grades
assumptions: Syllable counting is heuristic (vowel-group algorithm + exception list); scores approximate for non-English text.
Formulas validated for English prose; short fragments skew results.
source: R. Flesch (1948); J.P. Kincaid et al. (1975); R. Gunning (1952); E.A. Smith & R.J. Senter (1967) — canonical published formulas

name: Content Similarity Checker
formula: shingles(X) = set of contiguous n-word sequences (n = shingleSize, default 3, lowercased, punctuation stripped); Jaccard(A,B) = |shingles(A) ∩ shingles(B)| / |shingles(A) ∪ shingles(B)|; similarityPercent = Jaccard * 100; verdict: >=80 'very high overlap', >=50 'high', >=25 'moderate', >=10 'low', else 'minimal'

variables.meaning: intersection over union of shingle sets

assumptions: Word-level shingles; case/punctuation normalized. Paraphrase without shared 3-word runs scores low.
Verdict bands are editorial. This is NOT a plagiarism verdict — no web index is consulted.
source: Jaccard index (standard set-similarity measure); bands are MA2-defined

name: Content Audit Decision Tool
formula: score = 100 * (wT*T + wC*C + wQ*Q + wR*(10-R)) / (10 * (wT + wC + wQ + wR)); decision: score >= 70 -> KEEP; 40 <= score < 70 -> UPDATE; score < 40 -> DELETE/MERGE (manual review required)

variables.meaning: cannibalization risk vs other pages (user rating)

assumptions: All inputs are user judgments — no analytics integration (100% client-side rule).
DELETE/MERGE is a recommendation flag only; tool never deletes anything. Thresholds are editorial.

name: Freelance Writing Rate Calculator
formula: perWordRate = hourlyRate / wordsPerHour; per1000Words = perWordRate * 1000; projectQuote = perWordRate * projectWords + researchHours * hourlyRate (researchHours optional, default 0); dayRate = hourlyRate * billableHoursPerDay (default 6)
assumptions: Currency code is a display label only — no FX conversion (no rates source, 100% client-side rule).
wordsPerHour should include editing/revision time; warn if > 2000.
Quotes exclude platform fees/taxes unless user adds them.
source: Standard freelance rate math (deterministic given inputs)

name: UTM Link Builder
formula: taggedUrl = baseUrl + separator + 'utm_source=' + enc(source) + '&utm_medium=' + enc(medium) [+ '&utm_campaign=' + enc(campaign)] [+ '&utm_term=' + enc(term)] [+ '&utm_content=' + enc(content)]; separator = '&' if baseUrl already has '?' else '?'; enc = RFC 3986 percent-encoding (encodeURIComponent semantics)
assumptions: baseUrl must be absolute and parseable; existing utm_* params trigger an overwrite warning.
Values are percent-encoded; '+' in input is encoded as %2B (not treated as space).
Deterministic per Google Analytics campaign-URL parameter spec.

name: Meta Description Generator
formula: lengthGuideline: 140-155 characters target; pixelGuideline: ~920px max display width; keywordPresent = normalizedDraft includes normalizedTargetKeyword; score = 100 - penalties(length outside 140-155: -25; keyword absent: -25; no CTA verb: -10; >160 chars: additional -15), clamped [0,100]

variables.meaning: draft length in Unicode code points

assumptions: Google does NOT publish a character limit and frequently rewrites meta descriptions — 140-155 is an OBSERVED rendering range, not a rule.
Pixel width is estimated, not measured (font-dependent). Marked as ESTIMATE with effective date 2026-10-01.
A perfect score does not guarantee Google will display the description.
source: Observed SERP rendering range (industry convention, e.g. Moz/Google documentation note that length varies); not a Google-published rule

name: SEO Title Tag Generator
formula: lengthGuideline: <= 60 characters target; pixelGuideline: ~600px max display width before truncation; checks: keywordNearFront = keyword appears within first 40 chars (+15); brandPresent (+5); length<=60 (+40); 61-70 chars: warning; >70 chars: fail flag (will truncate)

variables.meaning: title length in Unicode code points

assumptions: Google does NOT publish a title character limit; ~600px/~60 chars is an OBSERVED truncation range, not a rule.
Pixel width estimated. Marked as ESTIMATE with effective date 2026-10-01.
source: Observed SERP rendering range (industry convention); not a Google-published rule
